development_evidence_seen_before_freeze: Official README, license, baseline source, paper text and released aggregate JSON outputs.
The first FinRank record and coarse release counts: 1185 records, 2322 gold occurrences, 6021 hard-negative occurrences and 5230 exact raw-text corpus entries.
Synthetic positive, negative, tie, candidate-permutation and first-occurrence fixtures.
Paper-disclosed quantities including 442 cross-record overlapping hard negatives and metadata-filter loss of some gold in 33 records and all gold in 2 records.
not_computed_before_freeze: Pair-level exact tie counts on the full released TF-IDF and BM25 score matrices.
Strict-win and half-credit pairwise macro scores on the full release.
Full-record source-identity overlap counts and first-occurrence metadata loss recomputation.
Seed-42 random-negative overlap with curated hard negatives.
Forward-versus-reverse corpus tie-order sensitivity on the full release.

application.object: All 1185 released FinRank records, official TF-IDF and BM25 matrices regenerated with the pinned official script, and the exact seed-42 random-negative draw.
application.development_application_boundary: Aggregate official results and author-disclosed counts were known; pair-level outcomes were not computed before this freeze.
application.reviewer_visibility: An independent reviewer may inspect the contract, source, released results and raw derived rows before reading Loop D's interpretation.

main_proposition: FinRank's tie-positive pairwise contract and first-occurrence text/metadata mapping can change absolute metric interpretation, while the paper's narrow curated-pool and source-attribution limitations may keep the hard-versus-random conclusion stable.
planned_observations: At least one released TF-IDF or BM25 positive-negative pair has an exact score tie.
Replacing ties-positive with strict-win or half-credit changes at least one macro pairwise accuracy by at least 1.0 percentage point.
The hard-versus-random gap keeps its direction and changes by less than 1.0 percentage point under the alternative tie policies.
Full-release source-identity recomputation matches the paper's 33 records losing some gold, 2 losing all gold, and 442 hard negatives across 305 records overlapping a different record's gold.

decision_thresholds.interpretation_changed: Gap sign changes, gap moves by at least 1.0 point, global tie order moves Recall@10 or MRR by at least 0.5 point, or source-identity counts conflict with the pinned paper/results contract.
decision_thresholds.narrower_contract_stable: Absolute pairwise scores move by at least 1.0 point but the hardness gap remains directionally and materially stable and disclosed source-identity counts reproduce.
decision_thresholds.no_substantive_impact: All fixed materiality thresholds remain unmet.

refutation_conditions: No exact ties occur in the released deterministic matrices.
Alternative tie policies reverse the hard-versus-random ordering or move its gap by at least 1.0 point.
Corpus-order tie handling moves global Recall@10 or MRR by at least 0.5 point.
Source-identity counts do not reproduce the pinned paper and official outputs.
decision_consequence: If the fixed application changes interpretation, report the exact affected endpoint and contract; if not, record a negative result. In either case do not convert author-disclosed limitations into a claimed correction of FinRank.
replacement_policy: Do not replace FinRank unless the pinned data, code or released outputs cannot support the complete deterministic audit. The current evidence is sufficient; no replacement is selected.
